name: Ice sheet / polar desert
notes: Permanent ice and polar desert (Antarctic interior, Greenland ice sheet, high-Arctic nunataks). Essentially plantless; only crustose lichens and a cushion moss survive on exposed rock edges, so the list is deliberately near-empty.

ground.name: Map lichen
ground.source: Rhizocarpon geographicum, bipolar/cosmopolitan crustose lichen on exposed rock incl. Antarctic nunataks; yellow-green crust <1 cm thick (Antarctic lichen flora refs)

ground.name: Antarctic moss
ground.source: Bryum pseudotriquetrum, cosmopolitan moss present in Antarctic and high-Arctic rock cracks; cushions 1-5 cm (British Antarctic Survey plant lists)
